label: Arduino UNO Q — edge motor fault (true FFT MCSA)

telemetrySchema.mcsa: Per-CT true FFT cooked spectra from the UNO Q Linux MPU. Each channel has fund [Hz,amp], rotor/bearing/ecc/pump [[Hz,amp],...].
telemetrySchema.edgeAi: On-device classification at motor start or spectral fault: healthy, seal_leak, clog_ragging, impeller_worn, bearing_wear, eccentricity.
telemetrySchema.tags: AI1–AI6 RMS amps (A0–A5), P1_RUN_FB/P2_RUN_FB, MOTOR1_FAULT/MOTOR2_FAULT, MOTOR1_START_MS/MOTOR2_START_MS. Optional Opta globals UQ_* on peaklogic/v1/g/{siteKey}/.

notes: Flash firmware/arduino-uno-q-mcsa via Arduino App Lab. Six 14-bit ADC pins A0–A5 (3.3 V max) take six CTs with no mux — A0–A2 pump 1, A3–A5 pump 2. Wi-Fi MQTT can also push UQ_* global tags to Opta (same broker + site key). See docs/projects/UNO-Q-EDGE-MOTOR-FAULT.md.
